messages:
oliver_win: Hello! new user on Windows. Followed the quickstart, set REDWOOD_API_KEY in env, ran `node quickstart.js`. First generate returned 200, then next request immediately got 403: 'onboarding_gate:billing_or_tos'. Strange because I didn't change anything between calls.
hana_sdk: thanks — can you paste the error body and whether you're using a user token or service account key? Also which sample (node/go/python)?
oliver_win: node sample. Error body: {"code":403, "error":"onboarding_gate", "reason":"billing_or_tos", "hint":"enable_api_access or request sandbox token"}. Using a user API key created from the browser. First call succeeded, second failed.
sam_support: context: we tightened gates to block sustained activity for un-onboarded orgs. Sometimes the initial token is issued before onboarding checks fully apply, so you can see a first successful call followed by a blocked one once the gate evaluates.
igor_prod: parity note: Go SDK already translates this to OnboardingBlockedError with a settings link; Node currently prints raw JSON. We should fix parity.
oliver_win: any way to detect this beforehand? It was confusing on Windows because CLI printed raw JSON only.
hana_sdk: good point. We should add a small preflight `GET /orgs/:id/status` or `GET /auth/whoami` in the quickstart and CLI so samples can proactively tell users if APIs are blocked. Filing DEVEX-2001 to add a preflight helper across SDKs and update the Windows notes.
cli-bot: DEVEX-2001 created by hana_sdk at 2026-03-29T10:05:00Z
sam_support: short-term: we can issue ephemeral sandbox tokens for Windows/dev users. Proposal: CLI accepts `--sandbox-token <token>` which you get from support or from an automated 1-click link. That avoids requiring billing just to try samples. Security will review token issuance.
igor_prod: product: we should also include a clearer in-app banner during workspace creation: "API access requires accepting TOS and adding billing or request a sandbox token." This will reduce first-call confusion.
oliver_win: two asks: 1) please make Node SDK show friendly message with a link to org settings when onboarding_gate is hit; 2) add a one-liner preflight in quickstart so Windows users see actionable steps instead of raw JSON.
hana_sdk: agreed. I'll implement the SDK mapping and a `client.ensureOnboarded()` preflight that prints exact next steps and a support link. Also will add a Windows troubleshooting subsection to the README about env var persistence and preflight.
sam_support: i'll prepare a support KB + a sandbox token workflow and a canned response for common onboarding_gate messages.
igor_prod: follow-up: please ensure logs include org id and gate reason so we can measure impact and iterate. tagging infra to add a dashboard for onboarding gate failures.
oliver_win: thanks all! that would have saved me a lot of head-scratching. :pray:
